TIGIL-PASADA LABAN SA KORAPSYON

Drivers and operators of transport group PISTON hold a protest rally along E. Rodriguez Avenue in Quezon City during their transport strike on Thursday, September 18.

The group called on fellow jeepney drivers to join their march to Mendiola Bridge near Malacañang Palace to denounce the massive corruption in the government.

Meanwhile, transport group Manibela ended its planned three-day strike following an appeal from the LTFRB.

📷: The STAR/Miguel De Guzman
